notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates an end-to-end financial analysis workflow where multiple spreadsheets and PDF documents are uploaded to a collaborative room, followed by an agent executing a SOTP valuation task and generating a final PDF report.

featureClarity.evidence: Shows file uploads and agent execution, but rapid actions reduce immediate clarity.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Captures the full sequence from empty workspace to final PDF report generation.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark UI, though high-density tables and missing PDF previews look slightly unpolished.

consistency.evidence: Aligns well with the files, spreadsheets, and agent trace workspace concept.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic end-to-end execution trace in a live browser environment.

legibility.evidence: High-density text and small spreadsheet cells are difficult to read at standard scale.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Demonstrates a realistic financial analysis workflow valuable for banking use cases.

productionHonesty.evidence: Transparently displays tool execution logs and actual output generation.

observedEvidence: Agent execution logs and tool trace
Final PDF report generation and rendering

defects.observed: PDF files show a placeholder stating 'Preview is not available for this file type' instead of rendering a document preview.
defects.fix: Implement a basic PDF viewer or thumbnail preview for uploaded documents.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent process financial spreadsheets and PDFs to generate a comprehensive SOTP valuation report.
